channel.title: The Daily Dot - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Dot (dailydot.com)

item.title: Madonna Confirms Julia Garner Will Star In Future Biopic
item.description: Madonna and Julia Garner are using their downtime between shooting for The Studio to co-promote other projects in Venice.

item.title: Lo-Fi Girl collabs with The Sims, but the timing couldn't be worse
item.description: The Lo-Fi Girl has collaborated with The Sims 4 for a Sims-themed lo-fi album — but it didn't get the reaction they were expecting.

item.title: Barry Keoghan Says Harassment Makes Him Want To Stay Inside
item.description: Actor Barry Keoghan reported in a recent interview that online hate and harassment has made him reluctant to go outside or work anymore.

item.title: Players agree that 'Pokopia' is chill—except for one yucky feature
item.description: Pokopia players are able to transport water via a feature known as waterscaping, but one TikToker posited an important nuance.

item.title: John Cena hugs fan battling cancer and shares words of encouragement
item.description: John Cena booked it into the crowd to hug a fan with stage four cancer.

item.title: Tim Cook says use your iPhone less. The internet thinks he's about to sell you something new
item.description: Apple CEO Tim Cook surprised all the millions of people who use smart phones by telling us to put them down sometimes in an interview.

item.title: 'Wonder Man' gets a surprise second season after word-of-mouth success
item.description: Surprise! Marvel's "Wonder Man" has officially been renewed for Season 2 at Disney+.

item.title: Olive Garden breadstick sandwich hack goes viral after Tinder date impresses TikTok
item.description: A Tinder date’s viral Olive Garden hack—turning unlimited breadsticks and salad into a sandwich—has TikTok calling it a major green flag.

item.title: Spider-Man Fans Are Ecstatic To See Peter Parker Broke And Miserable In 'Brand New Day'
item.description: A new trend celebrating the apparent depression Peter Parker's going through in the new Spider Man films may speak to the times.

item.title: Internet favorite Nicola Coughlan will explore the 'manosphere' in new doc
item.description: In a new season of Channel 4 anthology drama series 'I Am,' Nicola Coughlan will star as a woman whose partner is caught up in the movement.

item.title: 18 professionals share what they notice about a person's home that is telling about who they are as people
item.description: Redditors share a wide range of examples from their experiences going into people's homes for their work—and what it reveals.

item.title: Delta passenger opens Cheez-It bag mid-flight...there are only 3 crackers inside
item.description: A Delta passenger went viral after opening an in-flight Cheez-It bag with just three crackers inside, igniting debate over shrinkflation.

item.title: How a Reddit AMA became a PR crisis for rent rewards company Bilt
item.description: Bilt Rewards, a company that offers points for rent payments, may have destroyed all customer goodwill with a single Reddit AMA.

item.title: Newgrounds Roulette shuffles through the iconic (and sometimes forgotten) Flash animations of the early internet
item.description: A fun new website is bringing our nostalgia for Flash videos to the forefront by shuffling through classic Newgrounds animations.

item.title: 'I'm not owned!': Clavicular crashes out over 'SNL' parody
item.description: Controversial streamer Clavicular appeared rather displeased with a "Saturday Night Live" parody mocking his speaking style.
